name: Alert category
description: The subject of a public warning. These codes come from CAP 1.2 (OASIS), the standard most alert systems already use. Using the same codes means a warning actually reaches people, instead of getting lost because it used a system nobody else recognizes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Geophysical
hasDefinedTerm.description: Earthquake, landslide, tsunami, or volcanic activity.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Meteorological
hasDefinedTerm.description: Storm, flood, extreme heat or cold, or wildfire weather.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Law enforcement, military, homeland and local security
Medical and public health
hasDefinedTerm.description: A public health emergency, like the ones schema.org's SpecialAnnouncement was built for.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Pollution and environmental
hasDefinedTerm.description: Includes boil-water notices and air quality warnings.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Utility, telecommunication and other non-transport infrastructure
hasDefinedTerm.description: Water main breaks or power outages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear or high-yield explosive threat
hasDefinedTerm.description: A chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, or explosive hazard.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Other
hasDefinedTerm.description: Anything that doesn't fit the other categories.
